font_family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

primary.name: Medical Teal
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key brand elements

accent.name: Soft Coral
accent.usage: Urgent notices, heart icons, warm highlights

hero_bg.usage: Hero section background or side image

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, size 24px for standard, 48px for features

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-11 px-8 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-11 px-8 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors

cards.feature: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
cards.profile: overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

layout_strategies.hero: Split layout: Left content (H1 + Sub + CTAs), Right image (Rounded/Masked). Mobile: Stacked.
layout_strategies.grid_bento: Grid with varying spans. Use col-span-2 for featured services. Gap-6 or Gap-8.
layout_strategies.sidebar: Sticky sidebar for provider filters or documentation navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the new CSS variables defined in 'colors.css_variables'.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Ensure 'Manrope' and 'Public Sans' are correctly imported in index.css (already present, just verify usage).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Refactor the Navbar to be sticky, glassmorphic (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70), and contain the Logo, Nav Links, and a 'Patient Portal' button.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the Hero section using the 'hero_bg' image and the primary color palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Implement the 'Services' section using a Bento Grid layout with Lucide icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Create the 'Providers' directory using the card component style defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Ensure all forms (Contact, Login) use Shadcn Form components with Zod validation.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Mobile-first: Always design for mobile width first, then add md: and lg: classes.
